repeat.note: one dimension per entry of parameterRanges, each sized by that entry's own length; len(self) dispatches on the entry's actual Range/NumericRange/ParameterRange type - see core-spec.md Section 8; each dimension is labeled with (identified by) that entry's modelElement, in parameterRanges order

dimensions.note: one entry per ParameterRange child, in order, labeled with that child's modelElement (parameterRanges.modelElement is the modelElement of each entry, in order)

[id].ranges.note: the current value of each entry of parameterRanges, within the loop only

dimensions.note: one entry per ParameterRange child, in order, labeled with that child's modelElement (parameterRanges.modelElement is the modelElement of each entry, in order)

[id].indexes.note: the current index into each entry of parameterRanges, within the loop only
